subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in: jobs in tourism and hospitality; reading five job texts / Grammar Recall: first conditional and first conditional with modals
outcomes: Name skills and responsibilities of jobs in tourism
Form and use the first conditional
Use modals like may, might and should in conditionals

tf.s: Communication and languages are useful skills for a tour guide.
tf.why: Yes, tour guides talk to many visitors.

tf.s: Every job in tourism needs exactly the same skills.
tf.why: Each job needs its own skills and qualities.

tf.s: The first conditional talks about possible future situations.
tf.why: Right, for example: If I study, I will pass.

tf.s: 'Might' and 'may' can replace 'will' to show possibility.
tf.why: Correct, they show something is possible, not certain.

tf.s: 'If I get good marks, I will be very happy' is a first conditional sentence.
tf.why: Yes: if + present simple, will + base verb.

tf.s: A travel agent's main job is cooking meals for hotel guests.
A hotel manager must be patient to handle problems pleasantly.
tf.why: Yes, patience keeps staff and guests happy.

tf.s: A tour guide helps tourists from different countries.
tf.why: That is why languages are important for guides.
'Can' is a modal verb, like may, might, could and should.

tf.s: In the if clause of a first conditional we use 'will'.
tf.why: The if clause uses the present simple.

boxes.q: Which job needs a passion for food and creating menus?
Which skill does a travel agent need?
Complete: If you are tired, you ___ go to bed early.
Complete: If he ___ (not work) harder, he will lose his job.
boxes.why: The if clause uses the present simple.

boxes.q: Which job is done on planes?
Which word is a modal verb?
Why does a tour guide need languages?
o: To talk to tourists from different countries

boxes.q: Which sentence is a first conditional?
o: If it rains, we will stay home.
If it rained, we would stay home.

boxes.q: Which job books trips and holidays for people?
boxes.why: Travel agents plan and sell trips.

hunt.q: This job works on an aircraft
If it rains, we ___ stay in.
A skill a travel agent needs

mcq.q: How do we form the first conditional?
o: If + present simple, will + base verb
If + past simple, would + base verb
mcq.why: This form talks about real future possibilities.

mcq.q: Which job needs 'a mixture of skills' like a nurse, chef, waiter and cleaner?
mcq.why: Cabin crew do many different tasks on a flight.

mcq.q: Why must a hotel manager be patient?
o: To handle problems pleasantly and keep staff and guests happy

mcq.q: Which modal verbs can replace 'will' in the first conditional?
mcq.why: Modals change the meaning, e.g. possibility or advice.

mcq.q: Complete: If I study hard, I ___ a chef.
Choose the best modal for advice: If you want to be healthy, you ___ eat more vegetables.

What is the difference between 'we will stay home' and 'we might stay home' after 'If it rains'?
Which person would make the best cabin crew member?
o: Someone who can give first aid, serve food and stay calm
Someone who only likes cooking alone
Someone who cannot talk to people
mcq.why: Cabin crew need a mixture of skills.

o: If it will rain, we stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If you are hungry, you can eat.
If she studies, she might pass.
mcq.why: Do not use 'will' in the if clause.
